summary: An offer references a mandate hash whose mandate is validly signed but expired. Documented gap: the reference servers check mandate validity only at session initiation (spec §5.3), not per act, so an offer referencing a mandate that expired mid-session is not rejected today.

expect.reason: Intended behavior once mandate expiry is re-checked on every act; not enforced by the current reference servers, which validate the mandate only at session initiation.
